description: This file contains classes and functions for parsing and representing XML trees, including custom tree walker logic for processing nodes, comments, entities, and text within an XML document, specifically tailored for the html5lib library.

classes.name: Root
classes.description: Represents the root of an XML document, manages children including DTD if present.

classes.name: Doctype
classes.description: Represents the Document Type Declaration within an XML document.

classes.name: FragmentRoot
classes.description: Represents a fragment of XML nodes, used for processing node lists.

classes.name: FragmentWrapper
classes.description: Wraps individual XML nodes within a fragment, providing additional methods.

classes.name: TreeWalker
classes.description: Custom tree walker class for traversing XML trees with specific node detail extraction.

methods.name: ensure_str
methods.description: Converts input to a UTF-8 string if not already a text_type or None.
